transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose it's my eating. It's just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I... I just forget lunch completely. And other days I just find myself standing at the counter, eating crackers and sweets... even though nothing really tastes right. So... that's what made me come in.
Have you been intentionally cutting back on how much you eat, or avoiding certain foods because you're worried about your weight or shape?
No, it's... it's not about my weight. I just... I don't really have an appetite, I suppose.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with people?

Well... yes, I suppose. I used to go to things. Watercolor class, my quilting circle... the book club. I'd have my bag packed and ready by the door. But lately... I just leave it sitting there. I can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes... I suppose so. Most mornings I just... I wake up and there's this heavy feeling. It's low. Like... like all the color has just drained out of the day, before I've even gotten out of bed.
Have you noticed that you're feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even when you haven't been doing much?
I don't think so. I'm... I'm not really doing enough to get tired. I just sit in the chair mostly. So... no, not particularly.
